sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播精选访谈，供任何人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻报道权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: As the pandemic quickly spreads across the U.S., hundreds of hospitals are now confronting their first serious cases of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 随着疫情在全美迅速蔓延，数百家医院现在正面临首批严重新冠病毒病例。

sentences.en: Susan Dominus on the lessons of the first confirmed case in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·多米努斯讲述新泽西州首例确诊病例带来的教训。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月30日，星期一。

sentences.en: Sue, tell me how you first heard about James Kye.
sentences.zh: 苏，请告诉我你是怎么第一次听说詹姆斯·凯的。

sentences.en: Well, a few weeks ago, I heard about this young guy, a 32-year-old physician assistant, who was the very first patient in all of New Jersey to test positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 嗯，几周前，我听说有个年轻人，一个32岁的医师助理，他是整个新泽西州第一个新冠病毒检测呈阳性的患者。

sentences.en: And so I reached out to him while he was still at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 于是我在他还在医院时就联系了他。

sentences.en: And I was sort of wondering, would it possibly be okay?
sentences.zh: 我当时有点想知道，这可能行吗？

sentences.en: Could you maybe find some time to talk?
sentences.zh: 你也许能抽出时间聊聊吗？

sentences.en: And he said, sure, call me now.
sentences.zh: 他说，当然，现在就给我打电话。

sentences.en: I'm in isolation, in other words, and I have time.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我在隔离中，我有时间。

sentences.en: And what was the story that he told you?
sentences.zh: 他跟你讲了个什么样的故事？

sentences.en: So James lives and works in New York City.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯在纽约市生活和工作。

sentences.en: Okay, so my name is James Kye, and I'm a physician assistant.
sentences.zh: 好的，我叫詹姆斯·凯，是一名医师助理。

sentences.en: And his mother and grandfather live in New Jersey, and so he spends quite a bit of time there as well.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲和祖父住在新泽西州，所以他也在那里呆相当长的时间。

sentences.en: And I work as primary care, urgent care, and nursing home PA.
sentences.zh: 我从事基层医疗、急救护理和疗养院医师助理工作。

sentences.en: He came to this country when he was about 16 from Shanghai, and he's married and has a 20-month-old daughter whom he adores.
sentences.zh: 他大约16岁时从上海来到这个国家，他已经结婚，并有一个他疼爱有加的20个月大的女儿。

sentences.en: Why did you go into medicine in the first place?
sentences.zh: 你当初为什么选择从医？

sentences.en: Why were you drawn to medicine?
sentences.zh: 你为什么会被医学吸引？

sentences.en: Oh, because my grandparents, they are doctors.
sentences.zh: 哦，因为我的祖父母都是医生。

sentences.en: My grandfather is an anesthesiologist in Shanghai.
sentences.zh: 我祖父是上海的麻醉师。

sentences.en: And when I was young, I was always sick.
sentences.zh: 我小时候经常生病。

sentences.en: So I always went to his hospital.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是去他的医院。

sentences.en: So I had a good impression.
sentences.zh: 所以我留下了很好的印象。

sentences.en: And as someone working in the medical field, was James expecting to interact with this epidemic, the coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 作为一名在医疗领域工作的人，詹姆斯是否预料到自己会与这场疫情——新冠病毒——产生交集？

sentences.en: Was he maybe even thinking he would end up treating coronavirus patients?
sentences.zh: 他甚至可能想过自己最终会去治疗新冠病毒患者吗？

sentences.en: Well, he doesn't work in a hospital.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他不在医院工作。

sentences.en: And because he works in private practice, I think he probably imagined he might be working remotely with telemedicine.
sentences.zh: 而且因为他在私人诊所工作，我想他大概以为自己可能会通过远程医疗进行线上工作。

sentences.en: I heard about coronavirus many months ago when China had outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 几个月前中国爆发疫情时，我就听说过新冠病毒。

sentences.en: But I always followed the disease.
sentences.zh: 但我一直关注着这种疾病。

sentences.en: But because of his family background and because he does work in medicine, when news of the coronavirus did start coming out of Wuhan,
sentences.zh: 但由于他的家庭背景，也因为他确实从事医疗工作，当新冠病毒的消息开始从武汉传出时，

sentences.en: he definitely understood how quickly the virus could spread.
sentences.zh: 他绝对明白病毒的传播速度有多快。

sentences.en: And he definitely understood that the only way to guarantee that you could survive this was by not getting it in the first place.
sentences.zh: 他也绝对明白，确保你能挺过这一关的唯一方法就是一开始就别感染上。

sentences.en: Around the end of February, I kept food, frozen vegetables, dumplings.
sentences.zh: 大约在2月下旬，我囤了食物、冷冻蔬菜、水饺。

sentences.en: So soon after the coronavirus landed on the West Coast, he and his family went to Costco and stocked up.
sentences.zh: 因此，就在新冠病毒登陆西海岸后不久，他和家人去了好市多（Costco）大举囤货。

sentences.en: Our family plan is to stay home for two months.
sentences.zh: 我们家的计划是呆在家裡兩個月。

sentences.en: For like two months worth of supplies.
sentences.zh: 大概够用两个月的物资。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So they were going to avoid any meaningful exposure to the virus.
sentences.zh: 所以他们打算避免任何可能接触到病毒的机会。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If there was communal spread and it had become widespread, their plan was to shelter in place.
sentences.zh: 如果出现社区传播并且已经广泛蔓延，他们的计划就是就地避难。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And well ahead of the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 而且比我们其他人早得多。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 对，我想是这样。

sentences.en: So you weren't sure at what point you would start doing that, but you felt you'd know when it was time.
sentences.zh: 所以你当时不确定什么时候开始这样做，但你觉得到时候你自然会知道。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But, you know, he's stocking up at the end of February.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，他在2月底就开始囤货了。

sentences.en: You know, people in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，美国的人们

sentences.en: were still flying all over the country.
sentences.zh: 当时还在全国各地飞来飞去。

sentences.en: Kids were going to school.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在上学。

sentences.en: Bloomberg was in the race for president.
sentences.zh: 布隆伯格正在竞选总统。

sentences.en: People were planning vacations and weddings and, you know, all sorts of conferences and events.
sentences.zh: 人们在计划度假、婚礼，还有，你知道的，各种会议和活动。

sentences.en: And the same was true of James.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯也是如此。

sentences.en: So, like everybody else, he's going about his life.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像其他人一样，他照常过着自己的生活。

sentences.en: And around this time, without really too much concern about his health, he went to a medical conference in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，他对自己的健康并没有太多担忧，去时代广场参加了一个医学会议。

sentences.en: So I changed diaper for my daughter and gave her morning milk.
sentences.zh: 所以我给女儿换了尿布，喂了早奶。

sentences.en: And I kissed my wife to go to conference.
sentences.zh: 我亲吻了妻子去开会。

sentences.en: On the fourth day of the conference, Monday, March 2nd, he comes down with a cough.
sentences.zh: 在会议的第四天，3月2日星期一，他开始咳嗽。

sentences.en: And he starts to realize he's actually getting sick.
sentences.zh: 他开始意识到自己其实生病了。

sentences.en: I start to cough and a fever.
sentences.zh: 我开始咳嗽并发烧。

sentences.en: I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 我很累。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: So he leaves and texts his wife that he's going to go to New Jersey, where his mom has a house.
sentences.zh: 于是他离开并给妻子发短信说他要去新泽西，他妈妈在那儿有一栋房子。

sentences.en: His mom's away, and he doesn't want to come home and get his wife and the baby sick.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈不在家，他不想回家传染给妻子和宝宝。

sentences.en: Because of my daughter, when I'm at home, she always, like, hug me and kiss me, and she will catch it.
sentences.zh: 因为我的女儿，我在家时，她总是像这样拥抱我、亲吻我，她会传染上的。

sentences.en: And what's running through his head at this moment?
sentences.zh: 他此刻脑子里在想些什么？

sentences.en: Is he thinking, I have a bad cough?
sentences.zh: 他在想，我咳嗽得很厉害？

sentences.en: I might have the flu?
sentences.zh: 我可能得了流感？

sentences.en: Is coronavirus even on his mind?
sentences.zh: 他脑子里甚至有想过新冠病毒吗？

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 没有真的去想。

sentences.en: I mean, there had not been a single case in all of New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，整个新泽西州当时连一例病例都没有。

sentences.en: He thought he probably had the flu.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己大概得了流感。

sentences.en: By then, he was mostly feeling this bad cough.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他主要感觉是这种剧烈的咳嗽。

sentences.en: He had an elevated heart rate.
sentences.zh: 他的心率加快了。

sentences.en: His eyes were really runny.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛流鼻涕流得很厉害。

sentences.en: He had diarrhea.
sentences.zh: 他拉肚子了。

sentences.en: He was not feeling well at all.
sentences.zh: 他感觉一点也不好。

sentences.en: But he also was not alarmed.
sentences.zh: 但他也没有惊慌。

sentences.en: You know, he decided to go to one of those drop-in centers to get a flu test because he wanted to be told he didn't have the flu so he could go home.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他决定去那些免预约诊所做一个流感检测，因为他想听到别人告诉他自己得的不是流感，这样他就可以回家了。

sentences.en: So the doctor gives him a strep test and a flu teSt.
sentences.zh: 于是医生给他做了链球菌检测和流感检测。

sentences.en: They discuss whether he should get a coronavirus test, in fact, but the doctor didn't have one.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们讨论了他是否应该做新冠病毒检测，但医生没有这种检测盒。

sentences.en: So they moved on, and the results came back.
sentences.zh: 于是他们继续进行，结果出来了。

sentences.en: Although the strep and the flu test were negative, his symptoms were consistent with something called a pulmonary embolism, which is a clot in your lung that can be fatal.
sentences.zh: 尽管链球菌和流感检测呈阴性，但他的症状与一种名为肺栓塞的疾病相符，也就是肺部血栓，这可能是致命的。

sentences.en: So this could potentially be even more serious than just a seasonal flu?
sentences.zh: 所以这可能比单纯的季节性流感还要严重？

sentences.en: Yeah, certainly more serious than the flu.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然比流感严重。

sentences.en: So the doctor sends him to the ER of the Hackensack University Medical Center, which is not far from that doctor's office.
sentences.zh: 于是医生把他送到离那个诊所不远哈肯萨克大学医学中心的急诊室。

sentences.en: And in the emergency room, they ask me questions.
sentences.zh: 在急诊室里，他们问了我问题。

sentences.en: Ask me if I cough.
sentences.zh: 问我是否咳嗽。

sentences.en: I say, I do have cough.
sentences.zh: 我说，我确实咳嗽。

sentences.en: I do have shortness breath.
sentences.zh: 我确实气短。

sentences.en: So as called for, the doctors do a CT scan.
sentences.zh: 按照惯例，医生们给他做了一个CT扫描。

sentences.en: And after they do, they realize that, no, he does not have a pulmonary embolism, but that, in fact, because of the symptoms he's having and the way his lungs look in the scan.
sentences.zh: 做完之后，他们意识到，不，他没有肺栓塞，而是事实上，根据他的症状以及他在扫描中肺部的样子，

sentences.en: They see a ground glass nodules.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了磨玻璃结节。

sentences.en: So this can be coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是新冠病毒。

sentences.en: He might actually have coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 他实际上可能感染了新冠病毒。

sentences.en: And how do the doctors at this hospital react to that?
sentences.zh: 这家医院的医生对此有何反应？

sentences.en: Well, at this point, they haven't seen any coronavirus patients, so they don't seem to him terribly alarmed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在这个时候，他们还没有见过任何新冠病毒患者，所以在他看来他们并没有显得过分惊慌。

sentences.en: That said, they do put him in a tiny isolation room, a windowless room on the floor of the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，他们确实把他安排在一个极小的隔离室里，那是急诊室楼层一个没有窗户的房间。

sentences.en: That's where he spends the night texting his friends and his wife and, you know, getting increasingly unnerved and feeling quite ill.
sentences.zh: 他在那里度过了夜晚，给朋友和妻子发短信，而且，你知道的，越来越感到不安，感觉很不舒服。

sentences.en: I was nervous.
sentences.zh: 我很紧张。

sentences.en: And at the same time, since I'm in the hospital, I'm going to check everything.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，既然我在医院里，我要检查一切。

sentences.en: Make sure I'm OK, then I go home.
sentences.zh: 确保我没事，然后我就回家。

sentences.en: So then, on Tuesday, March 3rd, which is his second day in the hospital...
sentences.zh: 接着，在3月3日星期二，也就是他住院的第二天……

sentences.en: They decided to do a test on me.
sentences.zh: 他们决定对我进行检测。

sentences.en: So the test takes about 24 hours or 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 所以检测大约需要24小时或48小时。

sentences.en: They do a COVID-19 teSt.
sentences.zh: 他们做了 COVID-19 检测。

sentences.en: And they tell him he's going to have to wait a few days for the result, but he shouldn't worry.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他，结果得等几天，但他不用担心。

sentences.en: He's young and healthy.
sentences.zh: 他年轻又健康。

sentences.en: At the same time, he's wildly Googling symptoms for COVID-19 and realizing that he has almost every one of them.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他在疯狂地用谷歌搜索 COVID-19 的症状，并意识到他几乎每一种都有。

sentences.en: And so it's day three for James in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 对詹姆斯来说，这是他在医院的第三天。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, March 4th.
sentences.zh: 那是3月4日，星期三。

sentences.en: He's still waiting for the results in his tiny little room with a TV.
sentences.zh: 他仍然在一间带有电视的极小房间里等待结果。

sentences.en: And a local news report comes on.
sentences.zh: 这时本地新闻报道播出了。

sentences.en: But we begin tonight with breaking news regarding the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 但今晚我们从关于新冠病毒的突发新闻开始。

sentences.en: Yeah, that virus arriving in the Garden State tonight.
sentences.zh: 是的，今晚病毒传到了花园州。

sentences.en: Governor Phil Murphy announcing the first presumptive positive case of the virus right here in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 州长菲尔·墨菲宣布就在这里的新泽西州出现了首例疑似阳性病例。

sentences.en: And the news report says...
sentences.zh: 新闻报道说……

sentences.en: A man in his 30s is hospitalized in Bergen County.
sentences.zh: 一名30多岁的男子在博根县住院。

sentences.en: There's a guy in his 30s in Bergen County, which is where he is, who's tested positive for coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 在博根县——也就是他所在的那个县，有一个30多岁的家伙新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: It's the first case in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 这是新泽西州的第一例病例。

sentences.en: Governor Murphy saying...
sentences.zh: 墨菲州长说……

sentences.en: There's even a tweet from the governor of New Jersey confirming it.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州州长甚至发了一条推文来证实这一点。

sentences.en: We take this situation very seriously and have been preparing for this for weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们非常严肃地对待这一局势，并为此准备了数周。

sentences.en: I urge residents to remain calm...
sentences.zh: 我敦促居民保持冷静……

sentences.en: And it occurs to James, they really might be talking about him.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯突然想到，他们谈论的可能真的是他。

sentences.en: I asked the doctor, say, is this me?
sentences.zh: 我问医生，说，这是我吗？

sentences.en: And the doctor said, no, your test is not back yet.
sentences.zh: 医生说，没有，你的检测结果还没出来。

sentences.en: And of course, he hasn't heard anything about the results of his test yet.
sentences.zh: 当然，他还没有听到任何关于他检测结果的消息。

sentences.en: No, he has not heard anything.
sentences.zh: 不，他没有听到任何消息。

sentences.en: Well, you found out from the news from the governor of New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你是从新泽西州州长的新闻里得知的。

sentences.en: Yes, on TV.
sentences.zh: 是的，在电视上。

sentences.en: And I asked the doctor, the doctor says, oh, the result is not back yet.
sentences.zh: 我问医生，医生说，哦，结果还没出来。

sentences.en: And then the next day, his doctors come to him and say, yes, you have tested positive.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天，他的医生来到他面前说，是的，你检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And he is the first person in New Jersey to have tested positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他是新泽西州第一个 COVID-19 检测呈阳性的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And perhaps the first person in the history of the universe to find out he has a disease, not from his doctor, but from TV news.
sentences.zh: 也许也是宇宙历史上第一个不是从医生那里，而是从电视新闻里得知自己得了某种疾病的人。

sentences.en: Let's hope so.
sentences.zh: 但愿如此。

sentences.en: And how does the hospital react in this moment?
sentences.zh: 医院在这个时候有什么反应？

sentences.en: So he's really scared, but the hospital is telling him that he really has nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的很害怕，但医院告诉他其实根本不用担心。

sentences.en: He's a 32-year-old guy.
sentences.zh: 他才32岁。

sentences.en: He's got no pre-existing conditions.
sentences.zh: 他没有任何既往病史。

sentences.en: Even Dr. Balani was telling me, oh, you are so young.
sentences.zh: 甚至连巴拉尼医生都对我说，哦，你太年轻了。

sentences.en: It's like a flu.
sentences.zh: 这就像是流感。

sentences.en: In fact, one doctor even told him, if it's not because everybody talking about corona, you can go home already.
sentences.zh: 事实上，甚至有一个医生告诉他，要不是所有人都在谈论冠状病毒，你早就已经可以回家了。

sentences.en: You know, if it weren't for all this attention about the coronavirus, you'd be home right now, just getting better in the comfort of your own bedroom.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果不是因为对新冠病毒的各种关注，你现在就已经回家了，在自己卧室的舒适环境中慢慢康复。

sentences.en: In other words, it would probably just self-resolve in somebody of his health.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，以他的健康状况，这可能本来就会自愈。

sentences.en: That was definitely the expectation.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是大家预料之中的。

sentences.en: I think he felt that as a medical professional, he actually, he knew that he was quite vulnerable, that nobody was invulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我想他觉得作为一名医务工作者，实际上他很清楚自己其实相当脆弱，没有人是刀枪不入的。

sentences.en: And there was this disconnect between his own concerns and their own insistence that he was overly anxious.
sentences.zh: 他自己的担忧与他们坚称他过于焦虑之间存在着这种脱节。

sentences.en: It also dawns on him that he is the first person in this hospital to be treated for coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 他也突然意识到，自己是这家医院里第一个接受新冠病毒治疗的人。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm in real trouble when I come to this hospital.
sentences.zh: 我来到这家医院时，觉得自己真的摊上大麻烦了。

sentences.en: Because I feel they don't know how to treat this disease and that they don't have deep understanding about the disease.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得他们不知道该如何治疗这种疾病，而且对这种疾病没有深入的了解。

sentences.en: Nobody there has any experience.
sentences.zh: 那里没有人有任何经验。

sentences.en: Nobody there can make good predictions.
sentences.zh: 那里没有人能做出准确的预测。

sentences.en: Nobody there has institutional knowledge about what happens when this goes wrong or something unexpected happens.
sentences.zh: 当病情恶化或发生意想不到的情况时，那里没有人具备相关的机构知识。

sentences.en: He's the first person, and that's a very frightening position to be in.
sentences.zh: 他是第一个病人，处于这种处境非常可怕。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在该App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报App，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Sue, James is newly diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 苏，詹姆斯是最近才确诊的。

sentences.en: He's in isolation at this hospital in Hackensack, New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 他正在新泽西州哈肯萨克的这家医院接受隔离。

sentences.en: He's been there for about four days.
sentences.zh: 他在那里呆了大约四天了。

sentences.en: Physically, how is he doing at this point?
sentences.zh: 就身体而言，他现在情况怎么样？

sentences.en: When you first got the results of the positive test, on a scale of one to ten, how bad did you feel physically, ten being the worst?
sentences.zh: 当你刚拿到检测阳性的结果时，在一到十的范围内，你感觉身体有多难受，十是最严重？

sentences.en: I would say ten.
sentences.zh: 我会说是十。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He is feeling worse by the day.
sentences.zh: 他的病情一天比一天严重。

sentences.en: It's getting worse, so my heart is compensating, beating very faSt.
sentences.zh: 情况越来越糟，所以我的心脏在代偿，跳得非常快。

sentences.en: He definitely has that cough, and he also is having real trouble breathing.
sentences.zh: 他确实有那种咳嗽，而且呼吸也真的遇到了困难。

sentences.en: It's like I'm in the water.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我在水里一样。

sentences.en: Tell me more about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我多说说那个。

sentences.en: It's like normally we can just take very deep breath in and out.
sentences.zh: 就像通常我们只是深深地吸一口气再呼出来。

sentences.en: He describes it as that feeling when you're underwater and you have to come up to gasp for breath, but you can't quite get that oxygen that you want,
sentences.zh: 他将其形容为那种身处水底不得不浮上来喘气，却又无法吸入想要的氧气的感觉，

sentences.en: and it's a very panicking feeling.
sentences.zh: 那是一种非常惊恐的感觉。

sentences.en: It's a very scary feeling.
sentences.zh: 那是一种非常可怕的感觉。

sentences.en: So my lung is not allowing me to take deep breath.
sentences.zh: 所以我的肺不允许我深呼吸。

sentences.en: And how is the hospital treating him now that he's officially tested positive?
sentences.zh: 既然他正式检测呈阳性，医院现在是怎么治疗他的？

sentences.en: They move him to a room with certain protections in place, and they're keeping an eye on his numbers, and they're giving him oxygen when he needs it.
sentences.zh: 他们把他转到一个采取了特定防护措施的房间里，密切关注他的各项指标，并在他需要时给他吸氧。

sentences.en: And he's also keeping an eye on his numbers, and he's worried because he is not breathing well.
sentences.zh: 而且他也在关注自己的各项指标，并为此感到担忧，因为他呼吸不顺畅。

sentences.en: And on Friday, March 6th, his fifth day in the hospital, he worries that he is desaturating to a dangerous level.
sentences.zh: 在3月6日星期五，他在医院的第五天，他担心自己的血氧饱和度正在下降到一个危险的水平。

sentences.en: And what does that mean to desaturate?
sentences.zh: 血氧饱和度下降是什么意思？

sentences.en: It means that when you desaturate below a certain level, your blood is not getting enough oxygen from your lungs for you to function in a normal, healthy way.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当你降到某个水平以下时，你的血液无法从肺部获得足够的氧气，从而无法以正常、健康的方式运作。

sentences.en: And this is really concerning to him.
sentences.zh: 这让他非常担心。

sentences.en: But he still has the sense that the hospital is telling him he's overreacting, that he's being too anxious.
sentences.zh: 但他依然感觉到医院在告诉他他反应过度了，他太焦虑了。

sentences.en: He's going to recover just fine.
sentences.zh: 他会恢复得很好的。

sentences.en: I was confused, and also I was worried because I think I'm not getting enough care.
sentences.zh: 我很困惑，也很担心，因为我觉得自己得到的照顾不够。

sentences.en: And my oxygen level dropped, and they cannot even see it.
sentences.zh: 而且我的氧气水平下降了，他们甚至都看不出来。

sentences.en: And why do you think people in the hospital are saying that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得为什么医院里的人会这么说？

sentences.en: And maybe more importantly, why are they thinking that?
sentences.zh: 或许更重要的是，他们为什么会这么想？

sentences.en: Why are they insisting on being so calm about what it would mean to have an infection like this?
sentences.zh: 为什么对于感染这种病毒意味着什么，他们还要坚持表现得如此淡定？

sentences.en: I would have to guess that it's because the widespread impression that people had was that young people were not going to be terribly affected by this virus,
sentences.zh: 我只能猜想，那是因为当时人们普遍认为年轻人不会受到这种病毒的严重影响，

sentences.en: and that it was going to feel like a very, very bad flu, and that he was going to recover just fine, just like the statistics supposedly said he was going to.
sentences.zh: 而且这感觉会像是一场非常非常严重的流感，他会完全康复，就像统计数据表面上所说的那样。

sentences.en: And did you actually feel yourself having difficulty breathing at that point?
sentences.zh: 当时你真的觉得自己呼吸困难吗？

sentences.en: I just feel tightness.
sentences.zh: 我只觉得胸闷。

sentences.en: Tightness in your cheSt.
sentences.zh: 胸口发紧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I feel like very scary, very scared, and I don't know what to do next.
sentences.zh: 我觉得非常可怕，非常害怕，我不知道接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: And James is all too aware that no one in that hospital has ever treated anyone with coronavirus,
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯十分清楚，那家医院里没有人治疗过任何新冠病毒患者，

sentences.en: and he's really worried about his symptoms because he knows he's feeling worse and worse every day.
sentences.zh: 而且他真的很担心自己的症状，因为他知道自己感觉一天比一天糟。

sentences.en: So I told my cousin, I told everybody, and then they start searching.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉了我的表弟，我告诉了所有人，然后他们开始搜寻。

sentences.en: So he starts reaching out to friends of his who are plugged into the Chinese medical community,
sentences.zh: 于是他开始联系那些融入了中国医疗界的朋友，

sentences.en: including his best friend, who's a physician, and whom he calls his cousin, and his boss.
sentences.zh: 包括他的好朋友——一位医生（他管对方叫表弟）以及他的老板。

sentences.en: And they start making phone calls and trying to get information from experienced people who can maybe share what they've learned.
sentences.zh: 他们开始打电话，试图从有经验的人那里获取信息，这些人或许能分享他们的经验教训。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 也就是什么？

sentences.en: You know, there's advice that he should get high doses of vitamin C.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有人建议他应该大剂量服用维生素C。

sentences.en: There's some discussion of whether he should get a steroid treatment, if things get worse.
sentences.zh: 还有人讨论如果病情恶化，他是否应该接受类固醇治疗。

sentences.en: He translates the seventh edition.
sentences.zh: 他翻译了第七版。

sentences.en: They say that maybe he wants to look into antiviral medication.
sentences.zh: 他们说也许他可以考虑一下抗病毒药物。

sentences.en: They tell him he shouldn't wait too long before getting a second CT scan.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他做第二次CT扫描不要等太久。

sentences.en: But his doctors were really reluctant to do that.
sentences.zh: 但他的医生非常不愿意这么做。

sentences.en: Why was that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: They felt like they were giving him good care and that probably the results of the CT scan would not change that.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得他们给他的护理很好，而且CT扫描的结果可能不会改变这一点。

sentences.en: So James is more or less beginning to advise his own doctors on how to treat him based on his research,
sentences.zh: 所以詹姆斯多多少少开始根据自己的研究，

sentences.en: based on his relationship with other medical professionals, which is pretty unusual.
sentences.zh: 根据他与其他人脉广泛的医疗专业人员的关系，来指导自己的医生如何治疗自己，这很不寻常。

sentences.en: Yes, very unusual.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常不寻常。

sentences.en: And then the evening of the seventh, he starts desaturating to a level that really scares him.
sentences.zh: 然后，在7号晚上，他的血氧开始下降到一个让他感到真正害怕的水平。

sentences.en: He's concerned that if he desaturates to a certain degree, there could be no turning back.
sentences.zh: 他担心如果血氧下降到某个程度，就可能再也无法挽回了。

sentences.en: He'd have to be intubated, which definitely increases, you know, all of the risks of the illness.
sentences.zh: 他就必须插管，这绝对会增加这种疾病的所有风险。

sentences.en: It would mean that a machine was going to be doing all the breathing for him.
sentences.zh: 这意味着将有一台机器代替他进行所有的呼吸。

sentences.en: It could lead to organ failure and, in some cases, of course, death.
sentences.zh: 这可能导致器官衰竭，当然，在某些情况下还会导致死亡。

sentences.en: I mean, if I intubated at night, I probably would have just died by myself alone without seeing the loved ones.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我在晚上插管，我可能就已经独自一人死去了，都见不到亲人。

sentences.en: And his friends also, some of them, see this real urgency to save his life.
sentences.zh: 而且他的朋友们中也有一些人看到了拯救他生命的极度紧迫性。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of his friends said to me that he personally felt responsible for making sure that the doctors took James' case as seriously as possible.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他的一个朋友对我说，他个人觉得有责任确保医生尽可能严肃地对待詹姆斯的病例。

sentences.en: Here he is.
sentences.zh: 他就在这里。

sentences.en: He's the first health care worker in New Jersey also to come down with COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他也是新泽西州第一个感染COVID-19的医护人员。

sentences.en: If he didn't make it, it was going to feel like the battle was over before it had even begun.
sentences.zh: 如果他没挺过去，就会感觉这场战斗还没开始就已经结束了。

sentences.en: So you were scared.
sentences.zh: 所以你当时很害怕。

sentences.en: I mean, you were probably too weak to really speak forcefully, but you were letting them know that you felt that your life was on the line at this point.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可能虚弱得无法有力地说话，但你在让他们知道，你觉得此时此刻你的生命正悬于一线。

sentences.en: And we don't exactly know why, but on the 8th, he did get that second CT scan.
sentences.zh: 我们不太清楚原因，但在8号那天，他确实做了第二次CT扫描。

sentences.en: And he came back very bad.
sentences.zh: 结果出来非常糟糕。

sentences.en: It's bad.
sentences.zh: 很糟糕。

sentences.en: He has, you know, pneumonia in both lungs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他的双肺都有肺炎。

sentences.en: 30 to 40 percent of his lungs seem to be affected.
sentences.zh: 他30%到40%的肺部似乎都受到了影响。

sentences.en: That's astonishing that it would go from a small spot just a few days earlier to where it is now.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几天前还只是一个小斑点，现在却发展成了这样，这太惊人了。

sentences.en: And if he had gotten that bad in three days or four days since the last CT scan, how much worse was it going to be in another four days?
sentences.zh: 如果自上次CT扫描以来的三四天里他病情恶化得这么厉害，再过四天又会恶化到什么地步呢？

sentences.en: And now James starts to worry that he really might not survive this.
sentences.zh: 现在詹姆斯开始担心自己可能真的挺不过这一关了。

sentences.en: To God, to Buddha, to everybody saying, don't let me die.
sentences.zh: 向上帝、向佛陀、向所有人祈祷，别让我死。

sentences.en: Well, I know my oxygen levels keep desaturating.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我知道我的血氧水平一直在下降。

sentences.en: One of my requests is, can I see my mother and my wife or my daughter for the last time?
sentences.zh: 我的要求之一是，我能最后见一次我的母亲、妻子或女儿吗？

sentences.en: Because that time when my chest exercise shows so bad and my oxygen level every day is dropping.
sentences.zh: 因为那时我的胸部检查显示情况太糟了，而且我每天的血氧水平都在下降。

sentences.en: And I was telling myself to be strong, but I don't know how many days I can live.
sentences.zh: 我一直在告诉自己要坚强，但我不知道自己还能活几天。

sentences.en: And, but the good thing is after CT, they listened.
sentences.zh: 但是好在做完CT后，他们听取了意见。

sentences.en: When she saw a second CT, she was like, okay, we have to treat you.
sentences.zh: 当她看到第二次CT时，她觉得，好吧，我们必须治疗你。

sentences.en: I spoke to a doctor at the hospital who was part of the team overseeing his care.
sentences.zh: 我采访了医院里的一位医生，他是负责监督其治疗的医疗团队成员之一。

sentences.en: And he said they'd been looking at the whole clinical picture, had recognized that he was declining even before the CT scan.
sentences.zh: 他说他们一直在查看整体临床情况，甚至在CT扫描之前就已经认出他的病情在恶化。

sentences.en: But from James's point of view, everything changed after the scan.
sentences.zh: 但从詹姆斯的角度来看，扫描之后一切都变了。

sentences.en: He feels like now they're taking this very seriously and they're listening to him.
sentences.zh: 他觉得现在他们非常严肃地对待这件事，并且在听取他的意见。

sentences.en: They're coming around to seeing just how serious it is.
sentences.zh: 他们开始意识到情况究竟有多严重。

sentences.en: And also recognizing that, yes, even a young person can get very, very sick with coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 并且也认识到，是的，即使是一个年轻人，感染新冠病毒也会病得非常非常重。

sentences.en: And they're willing to try something.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意尝试一些方法。

sentences.en: And at this stage, what is he asking them to do?
sentences.zh: 那么在这个阶段，他在要求他们做些什么？

sentences.en: So then I, doctor in China recommend a high flow machine.
sentences.zh: 所以当时我，中国的医生推荐了一台高流量氧疗仪。

sentences.en: James wants a few different types of treatment.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯想要几种不同类型的治疗。

sentences.en: He's been advised that the doctors should try providing him a more intensive form of oxygen therapy.
sentences.zh: 有人建议医生应该尝试为他提供更密集的氧疗形式。

sentences.en: And he wants to go on three experimental antiviral medications.
sentences.zh: 他想要使用三种实验性抗病毒药物。

sentences.en: Cletra, chloroquine, and remdesivir.
sentences.zh: 克立芝、氯喹和瑞德西韦。

sentences.en: And at this point, he and the doctors at Hackensack and all the other doctors he's working with are pretty much all on the same page.
sentences.zh: 此时，他和哈肯萨克的医生以及他合作的所有其他医生几乎都在同一个立场上。

sentences.en: He finally gets the main things he's been asking for.
sentences.zh: 他终于得到了他一直要求的主要治疗手段。

sentences.en: And I think that the next day, Dr. Balani came in.
sentences.zh: 我想第二天，巴拉尼医生进来了。

sentences.en: He said, the medication's here.
sentences.zh: 他说，药到了。

sentences.en: We're going to give it to you.
sentences.zh: 我们要给你用药了。

sentences.en: And finally, after more than a week in the hospital, James starts to turn around.
sentences.zh: 终于，在医院呆了快一周后，詹姆斯的情况开始好转了。

sentences.en: He does start to feel better.
sentences.zh: 他的感觉确实开始变好了。

sentences.en: So after the first day, my fever finally dropped.
sentences.zh: 所以在第一天之后，我的烧终于退了。

sentences.en: And my oxygen stopped dropping.
sentences.zh: 我的血氧也不再下降了。

sentences.en: I'm getting better and better every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在一天天好起来。

sentences.en: So that's the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And does he have a sense?
sentences.zh: 他有一种感觉吗？

sentences.en: Do you have a sense?
sentences.zh: 你有一种感觉吗？

sentences.en: Do his doctors have a sense of which of these treatments was responsible for that?
sentences.zh: 他的医生知道到底是哪种治疗方法起到了作用吗？

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 并不清楚。

sentences.en: I mean, it might have been any one of the drugs or all of the drugs or the oxygen or some combination of that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，可能是任何一种药，或者是所有药物，或者是氧气，又或者是某种组合。

sentences.en: Or he might have just gotten better on his own.
sentences.zh: 或者他也可能只是自己好起来的。

sentences.en: We really don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道。

sentences.en: And so I asked you how you felt on a scale of 1 to 10 being 10 being the worst when you first got the results of the test and you said that you were a 10.
sentences.zh: 所以我问你，当你第一次拿到检测结果时，在一到十的范围内（十是最严重），你感觉怎么样，你说你是十。

sentences.en: On a scale of 1 to 10, how do you feel now?
sentences.zh: 在一到十的范围内，你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I would say now maybe 3.
sentences.zh: 我现在觉得大概是三吧。

sentences.en: That's pretty good, huh?
sentences.zh: 挺不错的，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, because I feel like all the symptoms are gone.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我觉得所有的症状都消失了。

sentences.en: I mean, I will be maybe no worry if tests come back negative.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果检测结果呈阴性，我可能就不用担心了。

sentences.en: Then I know the virus is dead.
sentences.zh: 那样我就知道病毒死了。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know if it's dead or not.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道它到底死没死。

sentences.en: It's now 10.37 and I need you to get good night's sleep.
sentences.zh: 现在是10点37分，我需要你好好睡一觉。

sentences.en: So I'm going to call you in the morning and see how your oxygen levels were.
sentences.zh: 所以我早上会给你打电话，看看你的血氧水平怎么样。

sentences.en: Is that okay?
sentences.zh: 行吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks, James.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，詹姆斯。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Sue, it feels, correct me if I'm wrong, like a big reason why James survived was because he was such an aggressive advocate for himself.
sentences.zh: 苏，我的感觉是——如果我说得不对请纠正我——詹姆斯之所以能幸存，很大程度上是因为他极力为自己争取权益。

sentences.en: And he had this network of expertise that he could tap into.
sentences.zh: 而且他拥有可以利用的专业知识网络。

sentences.en: He himself was a medical professional.
sentences.zh: 他本人就是一名医疗专业人员。

sentences.en: And that put him in a very strong position.
sentences.zh: 这让他处于非常有利的地位。

sentences.en: But I wonder why the people around him in this hospital were not better prepared given the stage of this pandemic when he arrived in Hackensack.
sentences.zh: 但我想知道，考虑到他到达哈肯萨克时这场大流行的阶段，为什么这家医院他周围的人没有做好更充分的准备？

sentences.en: We don't really know what saved his life because these drugs are still in clinical trials.
sentences.zh: 我们其实并不知道是什么救了他的命，因为这些药物仍在临床试验中。

sentences.en: What we do know is that the entire story of coronavirus in this country is a story of lack of preparation.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，这个国家冠状病毒的整个故事，就是一个缺乏准备的故事。

sentences.en: People did not believe that it simply was never going to be as bad here as it was in Wuhan or Milan.
sentences.zh: 人们不相信，这里绝对不可能像武汉或米兰那样糟糕。

sentences.en: That is a universal story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个普遍的现象。

sentences.en: It was hardly just these doctors at this hospital.
sentences.zh: 绝不仅仅是这家医院的这些医生。

sentences.en: I mean, part of it is that they are busy people.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，部分原因在于他们都是大忙人。

sentences.en: They are moving quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们的节奏很快。

sentences.en: They are saving lives every day.
sentences.zh: 他们每天都在拯救生命。

sentences.en: In fact, we all know that they're saving lives and putting their own lives on the line right now.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们都知道他们现在正在拯救生命，并将自己的生命置于危险之中。

sentences.en: But also, it is just hard to put yourself back in that moment, March 1st, March 2nd, or the end of February,
sentences.zh: 但同时，要把自己带回到那个时刻——3月1日、3月2日或2月底——确实很难，

sentences.en: and remember how unlikely we all still hoped and believed, against all evidence, that this wasn't going to be devastating here the way it was elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 去回想我们当时多么希望、多么相信——尽管有种种证据——这里不会像其他地方那样遭到毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: That said, to their credit, the doctors at this hospital were open-minded and they were flexible and they were nimble
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，值得赞扬的是，这家医院的医生思想开放、灵活且敏捷，

sentences.en: and they were willing to try whatever they could that was safe when they realized that whatever they'd been doing definitely was not working.
sentences.zh: 当他们意识到自己一直在做的事情绝对不管用时，他们愿意尝试任何他们能想到的安全方法。

sentences.en: And I know James certainly feels really appreciative, ultimately.
sentences.zh: 我知道詹姆斯最终肯定心存感激。

sentences.en: You know, he sent out a tweet that expressed his gratitude for the hospital's saving, as he sees it, his life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他发了一条推特，表达了他对医院救了他命的感激之情，在他看来是这样的。

sentences.en: So what do you think the lesson of this story is, of James, his very unique situation in these early days of the pandemic
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为这个故事带给我们什么教训？关于詹姆斯，他在美国疫情初期非常独特的处境，

sentences.en: in the United States, and of what happened to him at this hospital?
sentences.zh: 以及他在这家医院的遭遇？

sentences.en: You know, one of the things that I'm hearing from doctors is that until you are in this moment and experiencing the onslaught of patients, it is very hard to imagine it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从医生那里听到的一点是，除非你身处这个时刻并经历病人的冲击，否则你很难想象它是什么样的。

sentences.en: You can't really know until you're actually living it.
sentences.zh: 除非你真的身历其境，否则你无法真正了解。

sentences.en: And, you know, every hospital in this country is likely to have its James.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这个国家的每家医院都可能会有他们自己的“詹姆斯”。

sentences.en: It's going to have that first patient who comes in who is really ill.
sentences.zh: 都会迎来那种病情非常重的首批患者。

sentences.en: They're not exactly sure how to treat it.
sentences.zh: 他们并不完全确定该如何治疗。

sentences.en: We still really don't know how best to treat this virus.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上仍然不知道如何最好地治疗这种病毒。

sentences.en: That is the hard, cold truth of it.
sentences.zh: 这就是残酷的真相。

sentences.en: There are some protocols that we hope will help, that our thought might help, but it's unclear.
sentences.zh: 有一些我们希望会有帮助、大家认为会有帮助的方案，但目前还不确定。

sentences.en: It's so new, and it's going to be really hard for all those hospitals, and they're going to have to make difficult choices.
sentences.zh: 它是如此崭新，对所有这些医院来说都将非常艰难，他们将不得不做出艰难的选择。

sentences.en: They're going to have to make complicated ethical choices.
sentences.zh: 他们将不得不做出复杂的伦理抉择。

sentences.en: They're going to have to make decisions on the fly and build up their clinical experience.
sentences.zh: 他们必须随机应变并积累临床经验。

sentences.en: And it's not going to be easy for any of them.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的任何一个人来说这都不容易。

sentences.en: Sue, how is James doing at this point?
sentences.zh: 苏，詹姆斯现在情况怎么样？

sentences.en: I don't know when the last time it was that you spoke with him, but what did he tell you?
sentences.zh: 我不知道你上一次和他交谈是什么时候，他跟你说了什么？

sentences.en: He's home.
sentences.zh: 他回家了。

sentences.en: He is still in quarantine, so he still has not been able to see his wife or daughter.
sentences.zh: 他还在隔离中，所以仍然无法见到他的妻子或女儿。

sentences.en: And his lungs are still recovering.
sentences.zh: 他的肺部仍在恢复中。

sentences.en: It's unclear just how fully they will recover.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚究竟能恢复到什么程度。

sentences.en: You know, it's definitely a long road ahead of him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，前方无疑还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you know, he's reading the news, and he is feeling so lucky.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你知道，他在看新闻，觉得自己非常幸运。

sentences.en: Lucky to be alive.
sentences.zh: 庆幸自己还活着。

sentences.en: To be alive.
sentences.zh: 能活着。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sue.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，苏。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你现在怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Are you actually in your own home?
sentences.zh: 你真的在自己家里吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How does it feel?
sentences.zh: 感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: It feels great.
sentences.zh: 感觉棒极了。

sentences.en: I'm going to sleep on my own bed.
sentences.zh: 我要睡在自己的床上了。

sentences.en: Fantastic.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: At the hospital, I feel like I'm alive.
sentences.zh: 在医院里，我觉得自己活过来了。

sentences.en: I feel like everything is so new to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得一切对我来说都是崭新的。

sentences.en: The grass, trees, new people face, the sky.
sentences.zh: 草地、树木、陌生人的脸庞、天空。

sentences.en: And the way I drive on the road, I appreciate every building, every people I see.
sentences.zh: 还有我在路上开车时，我欣赏看到的每一栋建筑、每一个人。

sentences.en: I feel like it's a second chance to live again.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是重获新生的第二次机会。

sentences.en: To be alive.
sentences.zh: 能够活着。

sentences.en: What is the first thing you're going to say to your daughter and wife when you finally get to see them in person?
sentences.zh: 当你终于能见到你的女儿和妻子时，你对他们说的第一句话是什么？

sentences.en: I know you're quarantining for almost two more weeks now.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们还要隔离差不多两周。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, where I see my daughter and my wife, I definitely will give them big hugs.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我见到女儿和妻子时，我一定会给她们一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: Try to don't let them go.
sentences.zh: 尽量不放开她们。

sentences.en: I maybe will, like, have my daughter in my arm all the time.
sentences.zh: 我可能会一直把女儿抱在怀里。

sentences.en: I will come home and spend every minute with my family.
sentences.zh: 我要回家，和家人度过每一分钟。

sentences.en: I appreciate every day living.
sentences.zh: 我感激活着的每一天。

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: Have a great night's sleep.
sentences.zh: 祝你睡个好觉。

sentences.en: Thanks, James.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，詹姆斯。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for taking on me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们照顾我。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不用谢。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: In interviews on Sunday, members of the president's coronavirus task force delivered dire warnings about the pandemic's projected path in the United States.
sentences.zh: 周日的采访中，总统新冠病毒工作组的成员对美国疫情的预计发展轨迹发出了严厉警告。

sentences.en: No state, no metro area will be spared.
sentences.zh: 没有任何一个州，没有任何一个大都市区能幸免。

sentences.en: And the sooner we react and the sooner the states and the metro areas react and ensure that they put in full mitigation at the same time understanding exactly what their hospitals need,
sentences.zh: 越早反应，各州和大都市区越早反应并确保同时采取全面的缓解措施，同时准确了解医院的需求，

sentences.en: then we'll be able to move forward together and protect the most Americans.
sentences.zh: 我们就能携手前行，保护最多美国人的安全。

sentences.en: Speaking to NBC News, Dr. Deborah Birx said that the White House was asking every state to prepare for the kind of outbreak now occurring in New York,
sentences.zh: 德博拉·伯克斯博士在接受NBC新闻采访时表示，白宫正要求各州为目前在纽约发生的这种疫情做好准备，

sentences.en: where there are about 60,000 infections.
sentences.zh: 那里大约有6万例感染。

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Birx said yesterday, as you know, that she doesn't think any city will be spared from this virus.
sentences.zh: 嗯，伯克斯博士昨天说过，如你所知，她认为没有任何城市能从这种病毒中幸免。

sentences.en: How many cases do you think the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你认为美国的病例数会

sentences.en: will reach?
sentences.zh: 达到多少？

sentences.en: I mean, looking at what we're seeing now, you know, I would say between 100 and 200,000 cases, excuse me, deaths.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看看我们现在看到的情况，你知道，我会说在10万到20万例之间——抱歉，是死亡病例。

sentences.en: But I just don't think that we really need to make a projection when it's such a moving target.
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得，当目标在不断变化时，我们真的没必要做出预测。

sentences.en: On CNN, Dr. Anthony Fauci said that millions of Americans could eventually be infected and that between 100,000 and 200,000 could die.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·福奇博士在CNN上表示，最终可能会有数百万美国人感染，死亡人数可能在10万到20万之间。

sentences.en: What we do know, Jake, is that we've got a serious problem in New York.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，杰克，我们在纽约遇到了严重问题。

sentences.en: We have a serious problem in New Orleans, and we're going to be developing serious problems in other areas.
sentences.zh: 我们在新奥尔良遇到了严重问题，其他地区也将出现严重问题。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, the president extended federal guidelines for social distancing through the end of April
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，总统将联邦保持社交距离的指导方针延长至四月底，

sentences.en: and backed away from his previous plan to open up much of the country by Easter.
sentences.zh: 并放弃了此前在复活节前开放大部分国家地区的计划。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正准备迎接节假日的聚会。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，了解如何让你的客人在家里感到宾至如归的技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕过去才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
